newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Oct home appliance sales up 21.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Oct home appliance sales up 21.44 pct.

text.p: The volume of Brazilian home appliance sales jumped 21.44 percent in October versus the same month last year, home appliance makers association Eletros said Thursday.
The proximity of the Christmas season and the lengthening maturity of installments continued to weigh on sales, Eletros said in a statement.

October sales, in terms of units sold, also rose 3.57 percent against September, it said. In the first ten months of 1996, home appliance sales have risen 31.65 percent over the same period last year.
Eletros added that October white goods sales jumped 42.31 percent and portable appliance sales rose 9.57 percent when compared to October last year, it said.
October sales of TVs and stereos rose 10.03 percent against the same month 1995, it added.
